pheatmap Plot Orchestrator

Source: R/pheatmap_plot_orchestrator.R
PheatmapPlotOrchestrator.Rd

Reads the object pheatmap::pheatmap() returns as one subplot holding one heat layer (PheatmapHeatmapLayerProcessor), and draws its gtable for the SVG. Experimental.

Only the matrix is read. The dendrograms set the order the cells are read in but are not read themselves, and neither are annotation tracks.

When the cells' values cannot be read – not drawn with pheatmap(), which keeps them, and with no legend (legend = FALSE) or one labelled with words, and no numbers printed in the cells – the chart falls back to an image rather than being read without them.
